-- TTEX Talk Scene File: DO NOT EDIT BY HAND
-- Quest #119 / Scene #2 - Function Phindous_YuriandRazed_Stage
function Phindous_YuriandRazed_Stage()
	SetTransitionType(2)
	SetFinalMusic("")
	HideOriginalObjs(1)
	Phase1()

	LoadMap("mushroom01D.fld")
	MoveCamera(481.00, 267.00, 83.34)
	RotCamera(3.65, 1.30, 24.00)

	CreateObject(0, 1001, 351.00, 420.00, 11, 1, FALSE, 0, 0)
	CreateObject(1, 1001, 405.00, 364.00, 50, 1, FALSE, 0, 0)
	CreateObject(2, 1009, 435.00, 352.00, 55, 1, FALSE, 0, 0)
	CreateObject(3, 1009, 393.00, 388.00, 75, 4, FALSE, 0, 0)
	CreateObject(4, 1022, 357.00, 390.00, 75, 4, FALSE, 0, 0)
	CreateObject(5, 1022, 430.00, 378.00, 203, 8, FALSE, 0, 0)
	CreateObject(6, 1022, 456.00, 376.00, 20, 4, FALSE, 0, 0)

	Phase2()
	Phase3()
	Phase4()

	PlayMusic("BGM004.ogg")
	PlayCameraNoWait("Phin_YuriandRazed_Stage_01.cam", 0, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	wait(500)
	WalkObject(4, 367.000000, 380.000000, 75.000000, 1, 4, 4)
	WaitForObjectsStop()
	AniObject(4, 4, 1)
	WalkObject(2, 455.000000, 354.000000, 55.000000, 1, 4, 4)
	wait(500)
	WalkObject(5, 421.000000, 375.000000, 10.000000, 1, 4, 4)
	OpenTalkScene(12, 10)

	RevPhase4()
	RevPhase3()
	RevPhase2()

	Q.DeleteAllObject()
	RestoreMap()

	RevPhase1()
end

Register(Phindous_YuriandRazed_Stage)
